description: Retrieve state-level annual crime totals from FBI UCR data with national comparison, aggregated from monthly reporting. Returns year-by-year offense counts, rates, clearances, and clearance rates for both the specified state and the national average. Perfect for tracking state crime trends over time and comparing against the national picture. Supports 50 states + DC (2-letter code) and multi-decade date ranges back to 1979. Source: FBI UCR / CDE, US Gov public domain, no auth required.

from_year.description: Start year for annual trend data (e.g. 2010). Data available from 1979.

offense_type.description: FBI UCR offense category. violent-crime (murder+rape+robbery+assault), property-crime (burglary+larceny+auto+arson), or individual offense type

state.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation (e.g. CA, TX, NY, FL). All 50 states + DC supported.

to_year.description: End year for annual trend data inclusive (e.g. 2022). Defaults to last full year.

name: fbi.crime.state_annual

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: FBI UCR — State Annual Crime Trends vs National
